review_scope: MOD-CTRL-001 full independent-module re-review: public HTTP/SSE/MCP/A2A/metrics/capture boundaries, governance/firewall/model/target/plugin-statistics fences, PostgreSQL 18 schema and exact target-fleet identity enforcement, generated TypeScript client, supply-chain/vulnerability controls, real process/OCI and fresh module-gate evidence

findings.title: migration_reader compared the schema_version column as TEXT against an integer digest pin
findings.resolution: The schema_version readback is compared as the stored integer migration version against the pinned digest, and startup fails closed on an unknown or mismatched schema. Verified by the real-process PostgreSQL startup and ControlSink.CommitResults E2E.

findings.title: Migrations 0002/0005 embedded a subquery inside a CHECK constraint, rejected by PostgreSQL 18
findings.resolution: The CHECK constraints were rewritten to not contain subqueries; the full 0001-0024 migration chain applies cleanly against a real PostgreSQL 18 instance and migrate-test reports the pinned schema version.

findings.title: ControlSink mapped the wrong SourceWindow field for EventTimeUnixMS, misbinding inference result windows
findings.resolution: The result-record window fields are bound from the frozen inference wire contract; CommitResults commits the event before ACK and the real-process E2E verifies committed/idempotent/conflict ACKs against PostgreSQL.

findings.title: A nil currentBindingGeneration dereferenced during route-fence validation crashed the sink
findings.resolution: Route-fence validation treats a missing current binding generation as a fail-closed rejection rather than a nil dereference; the model rollout postgres E2E exercises stage/start/capacity/prepare/commit/resume and recovery without crashing.

findings.title: staticcheck flagged deprecated gRPC dial options, a regexp compiled in a loop and dead target-routing code
findings.resolution: outbound_clients migrated grpc.DialContext+WithBlock to grpc.NewClient (the existing health check gates readiness); the workload_ref regexp is precompiled; the unused clientForTarget method was removed. staticcheck ./... is clean.

findings.title: Mandatory Control public boundaries for bounded capture, MCP, A2A, metrics and operation APIs were absent
findings.resolution: Implemented bounded metadata-only capture on the sole effect-intent queue, private read-only MCP 2025-11-25, static-peer A2A 1.0 polling with grounded non-executable artifacts, bounded low-cardinality metrics, and canonical detail/operation/reconcile APIs. Public routes are checked against OpenAPI and exercised by unit, real PostgreSQL and process tests.

findings.title: Effect, firewall, fleet and model control paths admitted stale leases, gates or incarnation ABA
findings.resolution: Added renewable single-owner leases, no expired-claim blind reuse, pre-side-effect HOLD classification, target-scoped activation CAS/gates, immutable fleet completed-vector/manual gates and rollback, and model-control incarnation keys that fence restored same-number generations.

findings.title: Database and inbound boundaries did not fully enforce exact readback, verify-full and workload identity
findings.resolution: Added exact proposal/decision/readback foreign keys and manifest rows, application-role grants, schema-chain digest checks, PostgreSQL verify-full production requirements, TLS 1.3 client identity verification and exact inbound gRPC SAN authorization.

findings.title: Rule observation, plugin statistics and API pagination trusted caller or incomplete identity
findings.resolution: Rule epochs now derive only from exact Edge per-entry readback and exclude delete proofs; external-source capability and provenance are exact-fenced in plugin statistics; list projections use authenticated scope-bound keyset cursors with no OFFSET.

findings.title: Module gate could reuse stale binary, cached tests, stale source and non-starting OCI evidence
findings.resolution: The gate now builds a run-specific binary, disables Go test cache, executes all process and internal PostgreSQL tests, verifies binary/source digests after long-running commands, validates findings, and records an immutable OCI image ID after real startup/readiness/liveness/graceful shutdown.

findings.title: Public projections could conflate database failures with 404 or disclose facts across scope
findings.resolution: Database faults now map to bounded internal errors rather than false not-found; model incarnation/pool, target candidate conflicts, statistics history and all detail reads are scope-filtered; CSRF errors use the canonical JSON envelope.

findings.title: Control metrics lacked required latency, backlog, resource, domain and drift coverage
findings.resolution: Added fixed-dimension HTTP throughput/bytes/histograms, governance/firewall/target/fleet/model/plugin/statistics/A2A/MCP/rule aggregates, PostgreSQL transaction/lock/WAL metrics, CPU/RSS/FD/thread, config drift, certificate expiry and explicit series bounds with negative cardinality tests.

findings.title: OpenAPI client, immutable build inputs and reachable vulnerability controls were incomplete
findings.resolution: Added an exact-version OpenAPI TypeScript SDK generator and freshness/typecheck gate, a component adoption registry and lock validation, digest-pinned Go 1.26.6/Alpine OCI stages, patched chi/pgx/text dependencies, and a mandatory govulncheck gate with zero reachable vulnerabilities.

findings.title: Fleet projection PostgreSQL fixture created child intents without stable target facts
findings.resolution: The real PostgreSQL fixture now inserts two namespaced stable target facts before the parent/child fleet vector, uses those exact target IDs throughout waves, proposals and intents, and deletes them only after dependent facts. The focused and full internal PostgreSQL E2E suites pass under fleet_child_target_fk_v21.
